summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring FLUME encoding, capturing agentic journeys via Quadrature Nexus into SurrealDB, analyzing them with Mycelium and Ouroboros, and feeding synthesized patterns back to improve alignment scores in a continuously running self-improving loop.
summary.outcome: Successfully implemented E1-E6 (FLUME wiring, EVO lifecycle, Mycelium audit, Ouroboros exhaust, closed loop) and scaled to a 29,000+ run overnight autoresearch loop. Discovered and fixed the critical E57 bug (SET vs additive calibration semantics in `apply_mycelium_feedback`), mathematically characterized the Mycelium convergence formula, validated the full E3/E6 production pipeline (E62), and fixed several pre-existing test failures (ARC beam search UCB1, TriuneReviewer red_team_veto, async test callers, cache warmer).

repo: The FLUME VAE 256D encoding was completely stubbed with `z_vector=[0.0]*256` — never wired to ExperienceEncoder
Two distinct EVO classes serve different roles: `ExoticVacuumObject` is a biographical record, `AgenticEVO` is a physics puppet — complementary, not duplicates
The four QuadratureNexus voices map to QuadratureFabrics: Architect→space, Engineer→field, Ethicist→control, Resource→precipitation

`run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally SETs `_score_adjustments` on every call (line ~307), wiping any Mycelium adjustments before the next deliberation — this was the root cause of all E5/E6 failures
Two-layer calibration model: `_mycelium_calibration` accumulates cross-cycle (stable), `_score_adjustments` is reset per-deliberation by `run_llm_deliberation`

SurrealDB requires `RETURN true;` as health probe — `SELECT 1;` returns 400. Timestamps must use `time::now()` not string literals. SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields; pack EVO biography into `result` field (option<string>) as JSON
Mycelium convergence formula (E59): `consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n`, validated to max_error=0.00025. At lr=2.0 the formula closes exactly the full gap in one cycle
ARC beam search UCB1 conflates exploration policy with best-answer selection — transforms with 0 trials always rank above confirmed-correct ones; best_chain must track actual scores separately
TriuneReviewer.red_team_veto only checked strategy string for keyword 'contradiction' — missed CONTRADICTION signals in critique text output
The `autoresearch.md` file can be overwritten by concurrent sessions; use `docs/evo_autoresearch_findings.md` as persistent findings doc
Gemini worktrees are cleaned up automatically — never keep sole copies of code only in a worktree
`apply_mycelium_feedback` has zero production callers in `src/` — the fix is deployed but dormant until wired into the compound executor
Ouroboros fires HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (vacuum→dissolving resets) — 320+ false positives during autoresearch runs
The retirement criterion label mismatch bug: SCHEDULE labels (`E55_mycelium`) must exactly match the `experiment=` strings passed to `log_result` (`E55`) for retirement filtering to work
ManifoldEnv `verifiable` reward: `r_hiho = 1 - 4·var(position)` peaks at 1.0 when all dims=0.5 (HIHO). Optimal voice proposals earn +7.8 total reward per episode vs naive
SwarmEnv gauge coupling (strength=0.15) causes interference: all-optimal teams can underperform all-naive because large actions destabilize each other — mixed teams often best

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback used SET semantics (`_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`) — fixed to additive (`_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]`). Also added `_mycelium_calibration` to __init__. Mechanism changed from `score_injection` to `additive_calibration`.
_evaluate_resource extended with description keyword check (+0.10 bonus for cost/budget/efficient/resource/reduce) to match LLM behavior; previously only checked budget_available context flag

Complete rewrite from simulation to real HTTP. Key fixes: `RETURN true;` probe, `time::now()` for all datetime fields, `metadata={}` (empty object), EVO biography packed into `result` field (option<string>) to work around SCHEMAFULL restrictions on arbitrary subfields

UCB1 sort determines beam exploration but was also used to select best_chain — transforms with 0 trials (UCB1=∞) always ranked above confirmed-correct ones. Fix: track best_scored_chain separately by actual score, independent of UCB1 beam selection

red_team_veto only matched keyword 'contradiction' in strategy string, missing CONTRADICTION signals in perspective critique text. Fix: also check if any perspective critique contains 'CONTRADICTION: True'

Added ingest_evo_journeys() converting FlumeJourneyEvent metadata to JournalEntry with domain=evo_deliberation, and _synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill() extracting per-voice means. Per-voice mean extraction uses regex on 'voice_scores=[architect=0.850 engineer=0.832...]' format

Added check_journey_anomaly() detecting EVOs with evo_coherence < 0.50 as PhysicsAnomaly, consuming ExecutionExhaust and triggering healing. However this fires on experimental data as false positives (320+ times during research sessions)

New file: 11 regression tests for the E57 additive calibration fix. Key: synthesized skill format must use 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' pattern (not voice_scores=[...] which is the ingest input format, not synthesis output)

Inversion test data [[0,1],[1,0]] → [[1,0],[0,1]] is geometrically ambiguous — solvable by both invert AND flip_h. DFS returns flip_h first since it appears earlier in ops list. Fixed by using test data only solvable by inversion

Added _check_retirement() with two retirement triggers: (a) keep_frac=1.0 + CV<0.05 after 20+ keeps (converged attractor), (b) keep_frac=0.0 after 20+ runs (confirmed noise). E12 retires immediately (CV=0.00004 across all three variants)

Spin-loop bug at deadline: asyncio.wait_for with negative timeout (remaining_s < 10) raises TimeoutError immediately, creating a tight loop. Fix: guard with max(30.0, remaining_s - 10) and add `if remaining_s < 30: break` early exit

workflow: Autoresearch loop design: experiments should call nexus.deliberate() directly (not run_llm_deliberation) when the goal is measuring Mycelium feedback — run_llm_deliberation resets score_adjustments each call
Retirement criterion using CV of last 10 keep metrics prevents indefinite accumulation: E51 ran 4,786 times without stopping because no stop condition existed
Pre-specifying experiment metrics before running prevents redesign cycles — E50, E54, E60 all needed 2-3 redesigns due to no upfront achievability check
autoresearch.jsonl should be in .gitignore not git-tracked — pre-commit stash/restore fails when the file has ongoing writes from a running process
Gemini worktrees are automatically cleaned up — all new code must be committed to the main repo before the worktree exits
timeit.default_timer() is preferred over time.time() for experiment wall-clock timing — monotonic, sub-microsecond, unaffected by NTP corrections
IEEE 754 edge case: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 at n=10 — for threshold-crossing detection, use result.approved (exact comparison against class constant) not float mean comparison
Vault observations should be written immediately after each confirmed finding — losing context between sessions risks losing unvaulted learnings
The autodata keep_frac filter (4/9 experiments keeping) is the right signal — an autoresearch filter that keeps everything is not filtering at all

autorun_2h.py spin-loop at deadline: asyncio.wait_for accepts negative float timeout, raises TimeoutError immediately, creating CPU-maxing tight loop with no sleep

Label mismatch between SCHEDULE entries (E55_mycelium) and log_result experiment strings (E55) silently broke retirement criterion for an entire session before being caught

JEPA learning was bottlenecked by surprise_score(state, action, action) misuse (passing action as both action and observed_next) AND by train_step never being called — experiment ran 400+ times before diagnosis

E50 ceiling saturation: all voices were already at 1.0 from accumulated Mycelium calibration, so any additive boost had zero effect — required full experiment redesign as 3-tier naive/partial/optimal comparison

SurrealDB HTTP API discovery required trial-and-error: SELECT 1 fails, RETURN true works; string timestamps fail, time::now() works; metadata subfields fail in SCHEMAFULL, must use result field as JSON string
open_items: apply_mycelium_feedback (E57 fix) has zero production callers in src/ — fix is deployed in quadrature_nexus.py but dormant until wired into CompoundExecutor._mycelium_registry or equivalent

Ouroboros fires false HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions — needs a guard to distinguish production EVOs from autoresearch experiment EVOs (e.g., by agent_id prefix or context flag)
Mycelium synthesized skills are local per-experiment-run instances — cross-session learning requires persisting the registry state to SurrealDB or a file checkpoint between runs

SurrealDB experiment_runs table (HTTP-direct writes) was implemented in the Gemini worktree but not in the main repo overnight_evo_loop.py — 41,983 experiment runs in autoresearch.jsonl have no DB equivalent
E64 multi-cycle Mycelium compounding experiment committed but needs more validation runs — only smoke-tested, not confirmed with 20-keep retirement

JEPA world model learning is bottlenecked by flat input distribution in heuristic mode (all deliberations produce near-identical 12D state vectors at the 0.93 attractor) — needs LLM mode with real score variance to show genuine improvement

iGPU ROCm silent failure: Lemonade returns empty strings for evaluation prompts — all LLM-mode experiments fall back to heuristic; needs hardware/driver reset before LLM-mode validation of E63/E64 convergence formula
PR #113 (autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502) contains all session improvements and is open — needs review and merge
280 pre-existing test failures not addressed — systematically scanning and fixing (only 6-7 were fixed this session); need to understand which are real bugs vs flaky/environment-dependent

The retirement criterion uses in-memory state per process — converged experiments don't auto-retire on restart; cross-session retirement requires seeding _retirement_keeps from autoresearch.jsonl on startup
